description: The line plot illustrates the MRR@10 performance of various DPR (Dense Passage Retrieval) variants as a function of the number of queries used during inference (S), ranging from 1 to 10. The x-axis, labeled “Number of queries used during inference (S)”, is linearly scaled with integer tick marks at 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10. The y-axis, labeled “MRR@10”, is linearly scaled from 33.0 to 36.5 with tick marks at 0.5 intervals. Six distinct lines represent different DPR configurations: “DPR w/o query” (black solid line) remains flat at approximately 34.0; “DPR w/ gold” (yellow line with circle markers) starts near 33.0 at S=1, rises steadily to 35.0 at S=10; “DPR w/ top-1” (green line with circle markers) begins near 33.0 at S=1, climbs sharply to 36.4 at S=10; “DPR w/ bottom-1” (purple line with circle markers) starts at 35.0 at S=1 and declines slightly to 34.7 at S=10; “DPR w/ random” (blue line with circle markers) starts at 34.8 at S=1, rises slightly to 35.2 at S=2, then plateaus around 35.2–35.3 through S=10; and “DPR w/ curriculum” (red line with circle markers) begins at 35.5 at S=1, rises to 36.0 at S=4, then stabilizes near 35.9–36.0 through S=10. Two horizontal dashed lines indicate reference performance levels: a red dashed line near 35.6 and a green dashed line near 34.7.
